description: Na₄WO₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are five inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-20°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.51 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent WO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-19°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.68 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-20°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.44 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-19°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.72 Å. In the fifth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-20°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.34 Å. W⁶⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one WO₆ octahedra, and edges with eleven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-15°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.09 Å. There are five inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one W⁶⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅W octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one W⁶⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅W octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one W⁶⁺ atom to form distorted ONa₅W octahedra that share corners with five ONa₅W octahedra and edges with nine ONa₄W₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. In the fourth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two equivalent W⁶⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄W₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. In the fifth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one W⁶⁺ atom.
